note: A curated, ordered judgement about which OpenRouter free-tier models suit this workspace's tool-calling and strict-JSON planning workload, with no benchmark number cited or invented. It is not a skill measurement and not a claim that any id is available: availability is measured only by "python3 scripts/models.py --probe-free", whose observation is recorded in the availability block below. A paid id is refused with a reason and never routed. The order is a starting point; the refusal rules and the probe are what the workspace acts on.
ranking_basis: Free-tier ids only. Ordered by capability class for a tool-calling / JSON-planning workload: general model class and instruction-following reliability of the family, whether the family is published for tool use or structured output, and the risk of an experimental or older generation. Every placement is a judgement and says so in its own reason; no score, confidence or benchmark value is attached.
membership_evidence: Six ids were observed by this workspace itself in an OpenRouter catalogue read recorded on 15 September 2026 (research/implementation/provider-layer-20260915). The other ids come from each family's public free-tier listing and stay unverified here until --probe-free measures the live catalogue.

models.why: DeepSeek's general chat mixture-of-experts model and the strongest free-tier planner this workspace has observed in its own catalogue read; the family publishes tool calling and strict JSON output. Placed first on model class, which is a judgement, not a measured benchmark. Membership observed in this workspace's own 15 September 2026 catalogue read.

Qwen3 235B mixture-of-experts general model with strong instruction following and published structured-output support; placed second behind the DeepSeek chat model on class and schema adherence, which is a judgement rather than a benchmark. Membership observed in this workspace's own 15 September 2026 catalogue read.

Moonshot's agentic mixture-of-experts model, published with tool-use emphasis rather than chat polish; it sits in the top class on that positioning, which is a judgement about fit for a planning workload. Membership not observed in this workspace, so scripts/models.py --probe-free is what measures it.

OpenAI's open-weights large mixture-of-experts model, released with native tool calling and structured output; expected to be the most schema-strict of the free ids, and that expectation is a judgement, not a measurement. Membership not observed in this workspace, so scripts/models.py --probe-free is what measures it.

Z.ai's mid-size mixture-of-experts model: fast and reliable on single and short multi-task plans, and judged a little behind the top class on long compound plans, which is a judgement rather than a measurement. Membership observed in this workspace's own 15 September 2026 catalogue read.

Large Meta mixture-of-experts model with broad general capability, but its tool and strict-JSON adherence is why it ranks below the purpose-built planning models, and that reading is a judgement. Membership not observed in this workspace, so scripts/models.py --probe-free is what measures it.

Dense 70B instruction model: consistent at emitting plain JSON and weaker at multi-step task planning than the mixture-of-experts models above; a judgement on class, with no benchmark cited. Membership observed in this workspace's own 15 September 2026 catalogue read.

24B dense model with good instruction following for its size and documented function calling; adequate for a short plan and less dependable on a decomposed question, which is a judgement rather than a measurement. Membership observed in this workspace's own 15 September 2026 catalogue read.

Flash-class experimental id with tool support and low latency, but still an experimental id the publisher can retire without notice, so it sits mid-order in a judgement about durability as well as class. Membership observed in this workspace's own 15 September 2026 catalogue read.

The previous Qwen generation: solid instruction following and JSON output, weaker at strict schema adherence than the Qwen3 line; the placement is a judgement about generation, not a benchmark. Membership not observed in this workspace, so scripts/models.py --probe-free is what measures it.

27B open model with no tool-calling emphasis in its published positioning; usable as a last-resort fallback for a single simple task, which is a judgement about fit for this workload. Membership not observed in this workspace, so scripts/models.py --probe-free is what measures it.

Reasoning-first model that deliberates before answering: strong at analysis, but a planning turn needs a strict schema quickly, so it is placed last for this workload on that judgement alone. Membership not observed in this workspace, so scripts/models.py --probe-free is what measures it.

availability.reason: no OpenRouter key is configured, so availability was not measured and is not inferred from the ranking
